answers.answer: After taking Oathkeeper during Act, the Exile’s next Wake checks Usurper victory before the title flips, so they cannot win then. If they still hold the title, it flips to Usurper after that check; first win opportunity is the following Wake, or end of round 8 if that comes first while they remain Usurper. Losing it prevents victory; retaking resets to Oathkeeper and restarts the sequence.

Supremacy–Conquest: rule the most sites. People–Rebellion: hold People’s Favor. Protection–Sanctuary: hold the most relics and banners combined. Devotion–Faith: hold Darkest Secret. A Visionary needs a true Vision revealed, its goal completed at Wake, and at least 3 Visions drawn from the world deck by all players combined. For Conquest and Sanctuary, most means strictly more than every other player; a tie does not count.
answers.evidence: Oathkeeper title and four Oaths; Visionary victory.

answers.answer: At the ends of rounds 5, 6 and 7, roll only if Chancellor or Citizen is Oathkeeper. The game ends on 6 in round 5, 5–6 in round 6, or 3–6 in round 7. Chancellor wins unless a Citizen meeting Successor goal wins alone instead. An Exile Oathkeeper or Usurper prevents the roll.

Round 8 priority: (1) Chancellor or Citizen Oathkeeper means Empire wins, with qualified Citizen Successor replacing Chancellor; (2) otherwise Exile Usurper; (3) otherwise qualifying revealed Exile Vision, ties ordered Conquest, Rebellion, Sanctuary, Faith; (4) otherwise Empire, including if an Exile is only Oathkeeper, again with qualified Successor replacing Chancellor. Successor alone never ends game.

By current Oath: Supremacy—Citizen holds more relics and banners combined than Chancellor and every other Citizen; People—holds Darkest Secret; Protection—holds People’s Favor; Devotion—holds Grand Scepter. A Citizen cannot win by revealed Vision or becoming Usurper.

At Wake, if holding People’s Favor, either put 1 board favor on it or return 1 from it to a least-full suit bank, choosing among ties. Never take its last favor: at 1, add if able, otherwise do nothing. If Mob-side, repeat the choice once. Afterwards, if it has 6+, flip to Mob. Becoming Mob at this final check does not repeat payment that Wake.

Rest order: return favor on denizens/edifices to matching banks; return secrets on denizens/edifices/relics to your board and flip your facedown board secrets faceup; refresh Supply; move left once per unspent Supply, capped at leftmost; optional Rest powers once each in chosen order. Chancellor refresh by personal-bank warbands: 18+=6, 11–17=5, 4–10=4, 0–3=3. Exile: 9+=6, 4–8=5, 0–3=4. Citizen matches the exact Chancellor marker space, including leftmost.

Search costs 2–4 and chooses either world deck or your pawn-region discard pile. Discard Search costs 2. World Search costs 2 at zero Visions drawn, 3 at 1–2, 4 at 3–5; Darkest Secret makes that cost 2, other modifiers still apply. Draw 3 unless source runs out, a world Vision stops you, or a modifier reduces draw. World deck: draw one at a time; announce a Vision, stop immediately, advance Visions Drawn by 1. Discard pile: Visions do not stop drawing or advance track. Discard all but 1 before playing it, or discard the last too.

Discard facedown atop next region pile in cycle Cradle→Provinces→Hinterland→Cradle; order multiple discards freely, never same-region. Cards from hand/advisers use your pawn’s region. A card discarded from a site in another region uses that card’s region, not your pawn’s. Favor on discarded cards returns immediately to matching bank; secrets go to acting player’s board facedown.

Maximum 3 advisers total, faceup or down. Before exceeding it, discard one subject to locks; if incoming card changes limit, use new/lowest limit. Facedown advisers have no suit, restriction banner or power; any card can be held facedown. Later, facedown adviser can be played faceup legally or discarded as minor action. Faceup advisers cannot be discarded at will. A true Vision can be held facedown; Exile can play/reveal it to separate Revealed Vision space, replacing/discarding old revealed Vision; it is not an adviser. Chancellor/Citizens cannot reveal true Visions.
answers.evidence: Search Adviser and True Vision; Minor actions.

answers.answer: Muster (1 Supply): at pawn’s site place 1 favor on an empty denizen/intact edifice with no favor or secrets, gain 2 warbands from personal bank to board (Citizen gains purple). Relics/ruins ineligible; rule not needed, remote Muster not allowed. Trade (1 Supply) at same eligible card: place 1 secret to gain 1 favor plus 1 per matching faceup adviser from suit bank; or place 2 favor to gain 1 shared-bank secret per matching faceup adviser. Facedown advisers do not match; zero matches yields zero secrets, but pay the cost. Finite supplies limit favor/warbands; secrets unlimited.

Recover costs 1 Supply plus target cost. A facedown relic at your site costs its printed site cost (3 favor to indicated bank, burn 2 favor, burn 1 secret, or burn 2 secrets) and goes faceup to your personal bank. Either banner can be recovered from anywhere, including self/shared bank. People’s Favor: pay strictly more favor than it has, place payment on it, distribute its old favor singly to suit banks starting at any chosen bank and moving away from world deck in printed order/wrapping; flip to normal if Mob. Darkest Secret: pay strictly more secrets, place them on it; take 1 old secret and previous holder takes rest. From self all old secrets return to you; from shared bank remainder stays there. Recovering causes no seizure penalty.

Another player’s Darkest Secret is recoverable only if a suited card at their pawn site matches none of their faceup advisers. One mismatch suffices. Ruins/facedown advisers have no suit. With no faceup advisers, any suited site card is unmatched and permits recovery. Empty or ruin-only site protects it. Self/shared-bank recovery ignores protection.
answers.evidence: Darkest Secret protection, corrected by errata.

answers.answer: Defender: any other player who rules your site or has pawn there; if no player rules it, you may choose bandits. At least one target must be at your pawn site; if defender rules it, must target it. May target any defender sites anywhere (1 defense die each). If defender pawn is at your site, may target their relics (printed defense dice), banners (dice equal banner resources), or pawn and board favor together (2 dice). A co-located defender relic satisfies local target requirement.

Attacker selects up to attack dice equal to attacking-force warbands. Defense: shields, doubled per double-symbol with multipliers stacked, plus all defending warbands at targeted sites, defender board force if their pawn is at attacker or targeted site, and 1 per targeted bandit site. Doubles multiply shields only. Each attack skull kills 1 own force warband; count full swords plus each pair of hollow swords (leftover single is zero). May sacrifice surviving force for +1 attack each, but if sacrificing, exactly enough to win, never excess. Attack must strictly exceed defense; tie/lower defender wins.

Attacker victory: first defender kills half defending-force warbands rounded down, returns remainder to board; resolve defeated plan effects. Attacker then may place any number, including zero, of surviving force on targeted sites; zero leaves sites to bandits unless another power. Take all targeted relics/banners. Seized banner except by Recover: burn 2 resources, minimum 1; People’s Favor flips Mob. If pawn+favor targeted, may force defender to travel to a legal chosen site for no Supply and independently burn half board favor rounded down. Respect restrictions; Shrouded Wood enemy ruler chooses destination (Chancellor for Empire). Then attacker victorious plan effects; finally discard plans marked At end, discard.

Imperial defense: Chancellor automatically allies with Imperial defender. Other non-attacking Citizens may join with permission if pawn at attacker site or targeted site. Relevant modifiers ruled by defender/Allies activate; powers are shared as one defending side, but your site/board still means each user’s own. Allied board warbands add defense only if their pawn is at attacker/targeted site. Plans can be used at Imperial sites and from own advisers, not another’s; each plan once total by one paying user. Declared defender sets order/timing/priority if disagreement. Chancellor chooses Imperial casualties; surviving site warbands go to Chancellor board, Citizen board warbands stay. Citizen attacking Chancellor/another Citizen is non-Imperial for that Campaign; likewise Citizen defender when Chancellor attacks. Intra-Empire Campaign does not make all Citizens non-Imperial.

Base costs, destination regions Cradle/Provinces/Hinterland: from Cradle 1/2/4; Provinces 2/2/2; Hinterland 4/2/3. Travel to any different site, not only adjacent. Reveal facedown destination, add its printed favor/secrets from shared bank and printed relic count facedown from relic deck. Pay fixed-number cost first, then other increases/decreases. Free Travel is final override: spend-no-Supply power makes payment zero despite increases. Entry restrictions still apply unless ignored.

Grand Scepter holder cannot use its powers on the turn acquired. Later, holder (even Exile) may offer Citizenship to any Exile including self; must promise exactly 1 Reliquary relic. May additionally negotiate binding exchanges of favor, secrets, banners and non-Reliquary relics, and allow recipient to peek at Reliquary relics; other binding-deal powers cannot trade Reliquary relics. Acceptance: flip to Citizen, replace all own board/map warbands with purple (if insufficient, choose which to remove/replace), discard revealed Vision, flip Usurper to Oathkeeper, end own Act if accepting during it, refresh full Supply; exchange promised pieces; Chancellor gets newly uncovered mandatory modifier. Forced Citizenship uses same conversion but no negotiated offer/gift/exchange; only actual Reliquary relic removal uncovers modifier.

Next Oath: victory by Vision alone means matching Oath; any other/multiple victory means choose any except current. If Exile winner, flip all Citizen boards, including boxed, to Exile, then may offer Chronicle Citizenship to other Exiles except those just flipped. Each acceptor flips Citizen and replaces every garrison at each site they rule with exactly one winner-color warband. Rebuild deck from denizens still in play, excluding those retained at sites/Archive/Dispossessed: top 10 denizens + 2 random Visions (12); middle 15 + remaining 3 Visions (18); remaining denizens below. Aid’s 12 denizens + 2 is incorrect; top is 10+2, not 14.
